cd /workspace/dev && cat > /tmp/stress.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, time, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import kit, encode

random.seed(7)
N_TYPES = 4000
N_MODULES = 2000
N_ENTRIES = 32
N_EDGES = 8000
N_RUNS = 400
ARR = 64          # elements per array param
NPARAMS = 8
N_STATES = 2000
N_TRANS = 8000

types = [{"name":"Bool","kind":"bool"},{"name":"I32","kind":"int","bits":32},
         {"name":"Byte","kind":"int","bits":8},{"name":"Str","kind":"string","maxsize":16},
         {"name":"E","kind":"enum","values":["s%d"%i for i in range(8)]}]
# lots of extra named types (structs/aliases) reachable from a few modules
for i in range(N_TYPES):
    if i % 3 == 0:
        types.append({"name":"T%d"%i,"kind":"alias","target":"I32"})
    elif i % 3 == 1:
        types.append({"name":"T%d"%i,"kind":"struct","fields":[["f","T%d"%(i-1)] if i else ["f","I32"]]})
    else:
        types.append({"name":"T%d"%i,"kind":"array","element":"Byte","size":2})
modules=[]
for i in range(N_MODULES):
    mods = [{"name":"e%d"%e,"params":[["p%d"%j,"Arr"] for j in range(NPARAMS)]+
                            [["st","St"],["msg","Str"]],
             "result":["r","Bool"],
             "requires":["and",["all","x",["var","p0"],["lt",["var","x"],["const","I32",1000000]]],
                         ["match",["var","msg"],"[a-z0-9]*"]]} for e in range(N_ENTRIES)]
    modules = mods
modules=[]
for e in range(N_ENTRIES):
    modules.append({"name":"e%d"%e,
        "params":[["p%d"%j,"Arr"] for j in range(NPARAMS)]+[["st","St"],["msg","Str"]],
        "result":["r","Bool"],
        "requires":["and",["all","x",["var","p0"],["lt",["var","x"],["const","I32",1000000]]],
                    ["match",["var","msg"],"[a-z0-9]*"]]})
for i in range(N_MODULES-N_ENTRIES):
    modules.append({"name":"h%05d"%i,"params":[["q","T%d"%((i*3)%N_TYPES)]],
                    "result":["hr","Bool"],"requires":None})
types.append({"name":"Arr","kind":"array","element":"I32","size":ARR})
types.append({"name":"St","kind":"enum","values":["s%d"%i for i in range(N_STATES)]})
byname={m["name"]:m for m in modules}
calls=[]
names=[m["name"] for m in modules]
# DAG edges: entry e depends on helpers with larger index ordering guaranteed by name order
for i in range(N_EDGES):
    a = random.randrange(N_ENTRIES)
    b = random.randrange(N_ENTRIES, N_MODULES)
    calls.append(["e%d"%a, names[b]])
    if i % 7 == 0 and b+1 < N_MODULES:
        calls.append([names[b], names[b+1]])
machine={"states":["s%d"%i for i in range(N_STATES)],"initial":"s0",
         "state_param":"st","message_param":"msg","transitions":[]}
for i in range(N_TRANS):
    src=random.randrange(N_STATES); dst=random.randrange(N_STATES)
    machine["transitions"].append({"from":"s%d"%src,"to":"s%d"%dst,"command":"c%05d"%i,
        "cost":1+random.randrange(100),
        "when":None if i%4 else ["lt",["const","I32",i%5],["const","I32",3]]})
# ensure reachability chain
for i in range(N_STATES-1):
    machine["transitions"].append({"from":"s%d"%i,"to":"s%d"%(i+1),"command":"step%05d"%i,"cost":1,"when":None})
camp={"types":types,"modules":modules,"calls":calls,"pipes":[],
      "entries":["e%d"%e for e in range(N_ENTRIES)],"machine":machine,"runs":[]}
t=time.time()
plan_out=kit.run(camp)
print("compile-only run: %.1fs"%(time.time()-t))
plans=plan_out["plans"]
print("slots total", sum(len(p["slots"]) for p in plans), "variables total", sum(p["variables"] for p in plans))
m=byname["e0"]
def mk(params, result):
    objs,n=encode.build(types,m,params,result); return kit.encode(objs)
runs=[]
for r in range(N_RUNS):
    e=r%N_ENTRIES
    params={"p%d"%j:[ (j*1000+k) % 1000000 for k in range(ARR)] for j in range(NPARAMS)}
    params["st"]="s%d"%random.randrange(N_STATES)
    msg=[ord(c) for c in "msg%d"%r]+[0]*12
    params["msg"]=msg
    camp["modules"][e]=m
    objs,n=encode.build(types,m,params,True)
    runs.append({"entry":"e%d"%e,"ktest":kit.encode(objs)})
camp["runs"]=runs
data=json.dumps(camp)
print("input size %.1f MiB"%(len(data)/1048576.0))
open('/tmp/stress.json','w').write(data)
t=time.time()
out=kit.run(camp)
print("full run: %.1fs"%(time.time()-t))
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(r["status"] for r in out["records"]))
print("corpus size", len(out["corpus"]))
print("commands sample", out["corpus"][0]["commands"][:4], out["corpus"][0]["cost"])
PYEOF
